title: A clearance decision with AND, OR and NOT
objective: Combine NOT, AND and OR inside IF to build a clearance rule.
instructions: In F2:F7 use NOT to show TRUE when the line has not yet been marked down (column E is not "Yes"). In G2:G7 show "Clearance" when ALL of these are true: the range is NOT "Core"; EITHER weeks in store is at least the limit in B9 OR sell-through is below the floor in B10; and the line is not yet marked down (column F). Otherwise show "Keep".
hints: NOT flips TRUE and FALSE. =NOT(E2="Yes") is TRUE when E2 is anything other than Yes.
Build the decision from three parts inside AND: NOT(D2="Core"), then OR(B2>=$B$9,C2<$B$10), then F2 (which already holds TRUE or FALSE).
Put it all in IF: =IF(AND(NOT(D2="Core"),OR(B2>=$B$9,C2<$B$10),F2),"Clearance","Keep"). The OR sits inside the AND.
